title: US stocks today: US stocks rebound as tech rally gains momentum on easing oil, yields
summary: US stocks rebounded sharply on Thursday, led by technology shares as easing oil prices and lower Treasury yields offered relief after the Federal Reserve raised interest rates. The Nasdaq gained 1.66%, while the S&P 500 rose 1.14% and the Dow added 0.61%, despite lingering inflation and rate hike concerns.
